title: new every morning

verses.text: Because of the loving devotion of the LORD we are not consumed, for His mercies never fail.
They are new every morning; great is Your faithfulness!
“The LORD is my portion,” says my soul, “therefore I will hope in Him.”

caption:
Some mornings you wake up already tired.

Lamentations is a book of grief, and this is the line that sits in the middle of it. The mercy had not run out overnight. It was waiting at the start of the day, new and unearned, the way it always is.

Lamentations 3:22, 3:23 and 3:24 (BSB)
